_doc: Bloat firewall. Ceilings are NON-INCREASING and ratchet DOWN as code shrinks, never up without operator approval. Two operator-approved exceptions on record: the 2026-08-03 one-time test-pool correction at the Dream V1 landing (maxima 11600/85000), and the 2026-08-14 Breakthrough Pass raise (+300 production for the deterministic editor safety checks and the multi-page differentiation producer; operator authorized ratcheting mechanical budgets blocking the MVP, recorded here and in the campaign report). Enforced by scripts/check-foundation-budget.mjs (npm run guard:foundation). Foundation is frozen; see AGENTS.md for the growth policy and the 8-field feature rule. Third and fourth operator-authorized exceptions, 2026-08-16 final outcome run: ceilings set to the exact landed counts after the operator rejected the prior completion and ordered the continuation (canonical demand units + loader + history aggregate consumer, demand-recovery producer, answer-journey reasoning, self-starting backfill, generalized rendered reads, banked-copy earning re-read, and their tests); every ceiling remains exact-count and non-increasing from here. 2026-08-18 tenth-contract reconciliation, operator-approved interactively BEFORE shipping: the unapproved fifth raise was reversed (production ratcheted DOWN to 74,374 after deleting four dead modules; combined down to 87,097; exports back to 1,343 exact), and the operator approved tests at the exact landed count 12,723 because every line over the old ceiling is the contract's own counterexample suite (proposition search, typed failures, coverage chunks, dedupe, publisher diversity, global attempt bound, one canonical day, migration immutability, publish-not-called). Fifth authorized adjustment, 2026-08-19 AEO reconstruction (program clause: smallest exact ceiling adjustment after superseded deletion, recorded precisely): production DOWN 74374 to 73939 and exports DOWN 1343 to 1339 after deleting the Profound-era parallel AI record (canonical-store, cold-store, prompt-answer-observations dual write, citation-observations, the deep-dive ai_absence door and aiDemand); tests UP 12723 to 12835 for the AEO counterexample suite (fan-out recurrence, AI-seeded demand, staged cases, recurrence ranking, typed shipment scope, exact-scope measurement); combined DOWN 87097 to 86774. Net ceiling change is MINUS 323 lines. Sixth authorized adjustment, 2026-08-21, operator approval recorded verbatim after Codex accepted Phase 2 of the correction program: ceilings set to the exact landed counts of the deployed hardening pass (production 75,038; tests 13,815; combined 88,853; exports 1,374). The added code protects money (the pause is a spending boundary with never-cached permission), tenant security (service-role-only hardened verdict writer), concurrency (owner-token rebuild lease), durable decisions (ai_case_dispositions with superseded semantics) and the counterexample tests that caught live defects. This is a ratchet to exact counts, not permission for growth: Phases 3 to 10 must replace or delete enough to stay inside these numbers, and every ceiling ratchets DOWN when replacement work deletes code.

domains._note: The five kernels: account, evidence, decision, measurement, runtime. No new top-level domain without operator approval.

files._note: NEW production file may not exceed newFileMax. Grandfathered files below carry a non-increasing ceiling = current size; shrink them, never grow. Clearing a file (trim under newFileMax) is encouraged.

imports._note: src/app + src/components consume the 5 kernels through their public facade (index.ts) only. Deep VALUE imports of kernel internals are forbidden; import type deep-imports are allowed (erased at compile).
imports._directionNote: Dependency direction: Account -> Evidence -> Decision -> Measurement; Runtime orchestrates. Forbidden: Evidence importing Decision/Measurement; Measurement importing Decision. Known pre-existing leaks are grandfathered below (non-increasing) and tracked for severance; no NEW leak may be added.

exports._note: Exported type/interface/class/enum/const/function symbols in src (non-test). Non-increasing; keep internal helpers/types internal. Ratchet DOWN.

markdown._note: Documentation budget. Git history is the archive. No docs/archive/. No new AUDIT/REPORT/WIP/HISTORY/ROADMAP/dated-plan docs without operator approval.

deps._note: Runtime dependencies. Adding one requires explicit operator approval.
